description: Find Nova Poshta branches and parcel lockers in a Ukrainian city where an AkulaCyber order can be collected, from the directory the checkout uses. Use it when the user asks where to collect an order or which point is near them; for ship and delivery dates use akulacyber_estimate_delivery, and for delivery cost and payment akulacyber_get_store_policy. If the city name matches several places, the result lists them; call again with city_ref. At most 30 points come back; more_points true means there are more, so narrow with query. An unknown city returns an error.

city.description: City or village name in Ukrainian, Russian or English, e.g. "Київ", "Odesa", "Lviv". Give city or city_ref.

city_ref.description: The ref of a city from the cities list of an earlier result, to pick one of several matches.

lang.description: Language of the texts and page URLs in the answer: uk (Ukrainian, the default), ru (Russian) or en (English). Use the language the user writes in.

query.description: A branch or locker number (160) or part of the address (a street name) to narrow the list.

type.description: branch for Nova Poshta branches, locker for parcel lockers, all for both (the default).

name: akulacyber_find_delivery_points
title: Find Nova Poshta delivery points
